issues.title: Public PGO entry references unset or stale LASTEXITCODE after successful native orchestration
issues.evidence: Wrapper executes the winqual PS1 through & and then exit $LASTEXITCODE. The reviewed winqual script only has exit 1 on failure and no explicit exit 0 for DONE. It spawns all external processes through C# CreateProcessW rather than PowerShell native invocation. A fresh bundled PowerShell StrictMode semantic probe showed LASTEXITCODE unset initially and still unset after a successful scriptblock without explicit exit. Thus a successful native run can end with a StrictMode variable error, or inherit a stale nonzero code.
issues.recommended_fix: Add explicit exit 0 to the native winqual success path, or explicitly establish a success return status in the wrapper; verify both success and failure exit propagation using synthetic stubs.
